bib.title: Mini-Gemini: Mining the Potential of Multi-modality Vision Language Models

question: How can an academic-budget VLM approach GPT-4/Gemini-level performance by improving visual tokens, data quality and VLM-guided generation without raising the visual token count?
hypothesis: A second high-resolution ConvNet encoder queried by low-resolution ViT tokens adds detail without more LLM tokens, and higher-quality data plus text-bridged generation data improve understanding and add image generation.
contributions: Patch info mining: dual vision encoders (CLIP ViT for LR queries, ConvNeXt for HR keys/values) that enrich visual tokens without increasing their count
A high-quality dataset (about 1.2M alignment captions, 1.5M instruction conversations, 13K generation instructions)
Any-to-any workflow with text-bridged image generation through SDXL, supporting dense and MoE LLMs from 2B to 34B

method.summary: LLaVA-style VLM with a frozen CLIP-ViT-L low-resolution encoder and a frozen LAION ConvNeXt-L high-resolution encoder; cross-attention patch info mining (LR tokens as queries, HR sub-region features as keys/values) produces the visual tokens fed to an LLM. For generation the LLM emits a <GEN><h>...</h> prompt that SDXL renders, trained on 13K GPT-4 Turbo-built text-only instructions.
method.task: multimodal visual instruction tuning, image understanding and reasoning-based image generation

datasets.name: OCR-related QA
datasets.preprocessing: PaddleOCR text appended to conversations as 'Reference OCR token:Text_1,...,Text_n'; OCR detector used only to build data, not at test time

datasets.name: Generation-related instructions
datasets.size: 13K (8K re-caption from LAION-GPT-4V captions, 5K in-context prompt generation); from 10K GPT4V caption data and 6K LLM SFT data before format filtering
datasets.source: built with GPT-4 Turbo, 5 SD prompts from GigaSheet as in-context examples; about 80 USD API cost
datasets.preprocessing: filtered for format; <GEN> trigger and <h>...</h> wrapper; captions limited to 30 words in the re-caption prompt

datasets.name: TextVQA, MMBench, MME, MM-Vet, MMMU, MathVista

models.name: Mini-Gemini
models.architecture: LR CLIP ViT-L + HR LAION ConvNeXt-L, patch info mining, LLM; optional SDXL

other.visual_tokens: 576 for LR 336 input (N); 2880 (5N) with token extension at LR 672
other.HR_feature_map: upsampled/concatenated multi-stage features at 1/4 input scale, N' = N x M^2

training.objective: inferred: autoregressive language modelling loss on text outputs
training.lr: 1e-3 modality alignment; 2e-5 instruction tuning; 1e-5 instruction tuning for Mixtral-8x7B and Hermes-2-Yi-34B
training.hardware: 8x A800 GPUs standard; 4 machines for the 34B model
training.wall_clock: 34B: within 2 days; HD version about 4 days

other.frozen: both vision encoders frozen; projectors of patch info mining trained in all stages; LLM trained only in instruction tuning

inference.prompting: zero-shot benchmarks; generation triggered by <GEN> token, target caption in <h>...</h> passed to SDXL

metrics.name: MME
metrics.definition: perception score / cognition score as printed (e.g. 1659/482)

eval.protocol: Single reported number per cell; no seeds, variance or significance tests stated. Qualitative generation comparison against AnyGPT, ChatIllusion, LLMGA.

availability.weights: models released at the same GitHub

prompts.purpose: GPT-4 Turbo re-caption data generation (query + SD caption)
prompts.text: Hi ChatGPT, our objective is to create several high-quality captions that suitable for diffusion models based on the original detailed description given. ... Example high-quality caption formats (limited with 30 words each, descriptive and with some other property tags): {get_example_captions()} ... Requested format: Human Query: ... Related Caption: ... no more than 30 words long.

prompts.purpose: GPT-4 captions for conversation context (in-context prompt generation)
prompts.text: Hi ChatGPT, our objective is to create several high-quality captions for the following conversations used for generative models. ... the caption should be at least 30 words long.

evidence.quote: with an adjusted rate of 1e−5 for the Mixtral-8×7B and Hermes-2-Yi-34B to ensure stable instruction tuning

The 13K generation dataset cost about 80 USD in GPT-4 API calls.

results.claim: 34B model trains in about 2 days on 4 machines of 8xA800; HD version about 4 days.

results.claim: Authors state that higher resolution reduces visual hallucination (qualitative observation, no measurement).

limits: Counting ability and complex visual reasoning are far from satisfactory, attributed to missing pretraining data (Sec 5).
Generation uses text to bridge VLM and diffusion model because no apparent gain was found with embedding-based approaches (Sec 5).
Generation quality is shown only qualitatively (Figs 6, 10); no quantitative generation metric.
Single runs, no variance or seeds; baselines in Table 1 use different training data, so gains mix data and architecture effects (only Tables 2-3 control for data).
TextVQA numbers marked * include train-subset images; TextCaps data included in some rows.
Batch size, warmup, sequence length, precision and weight decay not stated; no data release for the 13K set stated in the text.
Fig 8 shows a failed case in image understanding.

terms.definition: Cross-attention where LR visual tokens (queries) retrieve cues from the corresponding HR sub-region features (keys/values) to yield enhanced visual tokens without extra token count
Extending visual tokens to 5N by encoding the original and 2x upscaled image split as a batch
